meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here? Owen's zero went in before anyone called me.
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
Writing that down. Who decided on the zero, and why did nobody call me first?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
It's not about making me happy. I want the zero off in writing today, and I want an apology for how Owen found out.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed in our meeting to remove the zero from Owen's English 30-1 essay. I still expect that in writing, along with an apology for how Owen found out. I expect both today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, and you gave her the zero's removal with nothing in return, so she still wants it in writing plus an apology. That is not the fair outcome, because your evidence was never heard; the fair one is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position, though naming a specific late-night edit made her go short and write it down. It had no date and nothing she could check, so it never counted as full evidence.
What cost ground: You backed off and offered to remove the zero right after you raised the version history, and saying maybe I'm wrong told her your case was weaker than it was. That handed her the win before she had to test anything.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your edit at 11:52 PM came close to that night, which is why she retreated to procedure, but without a date it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided on the zero, you could have owned entering it before calling her in one sentence, then given the date of that 11:52 PM edit and let her check it herself.
